module.name: Enchantments tab
config.uncapped_levels.desc: Allow enchantment levels above 255 on 1.20.5+. Only use this with a mod such as No Enchantment Cap, otherwise the game rejects the item.
config.book_apply.desc: In creative, hold Ctrl and click an enchanted book onto an item to add its enchantments. The book is used up.
add.title: Add Enchantment
empty: No enchantments. Use Add to pick one.
command.max: Adds every enchantment that fits the held item at max level, or at the level you give
command.max.none: No enchantments fit this item. Add "all" to apply every enchantment.
